universe_rule.outcome_blind: reuse the timestamp/identity-only 156-symbol eligible DEVELOPMENT universe already frozen for VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_RELEASE_PATH: >=40 distinct ISO weeks and >=30000 M5 rows; HIGH_QUALITY delta supersedes duplicate symbol IDs

signal.trend_state: For candidate resumption bar t and pullback length P, trend anchor is close[t-P-1]. Compute direction from log(close[t-P-1]/close[t-P-1-H]); normalize by 1.4826*median(abs(one-bar log returns)) over the H completed returns ending at t-P-1 times sqrt(H). Require absolute normalized trend >=1.0; direction is its sign.
signal.pullback: Over the P completed bars immediately after the trend anchor and ending t-1, require cumulative log return opposite the frozen trend direction with absolute magnitude >= pullback_magnitude * long_scale * sqrt(P).
signal.resumption: Completed bar t must close in the original trend direction beyond the two immediately preceding pullback-bar extremes: LONG close_t > max(high[t-2],high[t-1]); SHORT close_t < min(low[t-2],low[t-1]).
signal.entry: next contiguous M5 open t+1 after resumption bar has completed
signal.overlap_policy: within each symbol x frozen cell, ignore later signals until the accepted position exits
signal.failure_exit: LONG: if completed post-entry close <= minimum low of the P pullback bars, exit next contiguous M5 open; SHORT symmetric at maximum high of pullback bars.
signal.time_exit: if no failure, exit at next contiguous open after maximum_hold_bars completed post-entry M5 bars
signal.missing_or_ambiguous: right-censor fail-closed; no interpolation, resampling, gap bridging, synthetic fills, or same-bar execution claims

multiplicity.family: all 3744 frozen symbol x parameter cells
multiplicity.support_rule_predeclared: All 3744 cells remain family members. Only cells meeting non-return support prerequisites (>=40 completed events, >=30 dates, >=20 ISO weeks, retention>=0.80) may generate finite studentized statistics in max-T; support-ineligible cells are assigned familywise p=1 and cannot pass.
